name: The Chalk of The Seven Seas

pages.title: Marid Lure
pages.text: Just as the red chalk is made from the essence of Afrit, the blue chalk is made$(br) from the essence of Marid, allowing for control over these powerful spirits.$(br)

The purpose of the blue chalk is to overcome the willpower of a Marid; its sometimes$(br) excessive use serves as a guarantee that any Marid will be controlled.$(br) Should the control fail, it would generate extreme fury in the invoked Marid.$()
To obtain the essence of a $(#AA00AA)Marid$() for $(item)Blue Chalk$() you need to$(br) $(l:summoning_rituals/marid_essence)summon and kill an Unbound Marid$(/l).$(br)
